title.value: China Scholarship Council - Adelaide University Partnership Scholarship Program
title.evidence_quote: China Scholarship Council - Adelaide University Partnership Scholarship Program

qualifications: For PhD commencement between July 2027 and June 2028
Requires an unconditional Adelaide offer that depends on also winning a CSC award
After Adelaide nomination, applicants apply to the China Scholarship Council around April to May 2027
The university fee contribution goes only to candidates it nominates
description_short: Adelaide University and the China Scholarship Council partnership for PhD study starting between July 2027 and June 2028. Applications to Adelaide run 1 October 2026 to 1 February 2027; nominated candidates then apply to the CSC around April-May 2027.

deadline.evidence_quote: Applications run from 1 October 2026 to 1 February 2027, for candidates commencing their PhD between July 2027 and June 2028

status_evidence: Official Adelaide research scholarships page (search results): 2027 round open 1 October 2026 to 1 February 2027
